workLog.task: Measure a stacked PR against its own base
workLog.outcome: Added rescope_against_pr_base so a stacked branch stops counting its parent's files; 77 tests passed, all mocked

workLog.task: Adversarial review on a different model family
workLog.outcome: GPT 5.6 Sol returned INCORRECT with four findings; each was checked against source or a live command before acceptance, and three reproduced
Restricted the PR lookup to a single open PR, refused an empty or None rescope, skipped rescoping while MERGE_HEAD exists, and added a subset invariant; 88 tests and four mutation controls

workLog.task: Split the module after the size ratchet regressed
workLog.outcome: taste_count_ratchet reported 584 against baseline 583; extracted scripts/scope_pr_base.py rather than suppressing, and the ratchet returned to OK at 583

workLog.task: Correct two claims found while writing the retrospective
workLog.outcome: Issue #4382 is closed rather than open, and the _branch test helper was typed str while get_current_branch returns str or None; mypy caught the second

workLog.task: Second adversarial review on GPT-5.6 Sol returned INCORRECT with 8 findings
workLog.outcome: Four reproduced and were fixed; four are real but pre-existing or need server-side enforcement, and are documented on the PR rather than changed

workLog.task: Test the subset invariant against a real git graph instead of reasoning about it
workLog.outcome: Disproved. main with 52 files, parent changes all 52, child reverts one: the child changes 1 file against its parent and that file is absent from the 51-file main-relative set. Containment rejected the honest stacked PR the feature exists to unblock

workLog.task: Design and verify a replacement invariant
workLog.outcome: Strict fork-point ancestry. Rejected 'main is an ancestor of the base' after measuring that one commit on main invalidates an open stack. Verified the replacement accepts the real stack and rejects both an unrelated sibling and main itself

workLog.task: Add real-git tests and run six mutation controls
workLog.outcome: 146 pass. The first draft of the real-git file did not chdir, so is_ancestor ran in the wrong repository and all three reject cases passed vacuously; a positive control now guards that. Mutation 4 (drop baseRefName validation) survived the suite and exposed a missing wiring test, now added

workLog.task: Take the third adversarial review (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and close its findings
workLog.outcome: Verdict CORRECT on the fork-point rule after the reviewer built its own repositories covering honest, rebased, sibling, and descendant stacks. It found three surviving mutations and one tautological assertion; all four fixed, 149 tests. The reviewer left the working tree mutated despite an explicit restore instruction, caught by git status before the next commit

workLog.task: Fix the two live Copilot review threads on PR #4738
workLog.outcome: The gh pr list --head finding is real: --head filters on branch name alone, so a fork PR sharing this branch's name is the single match when the local branch has no PR, and a stranger picks the base. Fixed by requiring isCrossRepository to be exactly False, with four mutation controls. The retro remediation table gained the Owner / Issue column retros.md item 4 requires, and the open item now has issue #4743

workLog.outcome: TestIsCredibleRescope moved to tests/test_scope_pr_base_credibility.py along the seam the module docstring already names. Taste ratchet returned from 584 to baseline 583. 160 tests pass
